summary: The prepared base still had the reported GDN indexed-write dtype defect. Reproduced both mismatch directions on CPU and gfx950, then adapted the narrow cache-boundary conversion from open upstream PR 36289 and added broader boundary coverage.

tests.command: ROCm device inventory plus prepared-Python indexed assignments for BF16 cache/FP16 source and FP32 cache/BF16 source on CPU and cuda:0
tests.what_was_measured: Before the fix, PyTorch raised the reported index_put dtype mismatch in both directions on CPU and the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950. Raw output: reports/j-53d2e387139b/raw/before_dtype_mismatch.txt

17 tests and 27 subtests passed, including cross-dtype, same-dtype, selected-slot, untouched-slot, and empty-selection regressions. Raw output: reports/j-53d2e387139b/raw/pytest_gdn_prefill_backend_policy.txt

tests.command: Prepared-Python gfx950 numerical check invoking _store_tracked_conv_states for FP16/BF16, BF16/FP16, and FP32/BF16 cache/source pairs
tests.what_was_measured: GPU results exactly equaled an independently constructed source.to(cache_dtype) reference and non-selected slots remained unchanged. Raw output: reports/j-53d2e387139b/raw/gpu_tracked_conv_state.txt
Repository formatting, lint, AST, registry, and file-integrity hooks passed for the changed source and test files.

gpu_evidence: AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 (unique ID 0xfa55ca8c650dfefb) executed the failing-before indexed writes and passing-after source helper checks; see raw/before_dtype_mismatch.txt and raw/gpu_tracked_conv_state.txt.
remaining_limitations: QuantTrio/Qwen3.6-27B-AWQ weights were unavailable, so the reported full serving path and semantic output were not reproduced.
The report used ROCm 7.2 on gfx950 rather than the reporter's CUDA 13.3 SM120 environment.
The GPU fixture validates the implicated GDN cache write only; it does not qualify the Qwen3.6 architecture or full-model execution.
Upstream PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/36289 already proposed the same narrow boundary conversion but remained open and absent from this base when inspected.
